headline.title: First flakes for Laurel Highlands.
headline.text: Up to {{s:8.2}} on the summit of Seven Springs Thursday morning to Friday night. 17 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in Western Maine and Northern Vermont. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
A cooler and unsettled pattern is expected this weekend with summit level snow possible Sunday morning.
Another round of precipitation expected for the start of the work week, with this activity more focused in the favored upslope areas of the northern mountains.
Remaining unsettled midweek through the end of the week, likely trending cooler by next weekend.

ALY.excerpt:
) An upper level low will bring periods of rain to the region today into early Sunday though no hydrological impacts are expected.
) Some additional light showers are expected next week as a series of disturbances pass through the area before a larger upper trough builds overhead later in the week.

GYX.excerpt:
Beneficial rainfall expands inland tonight with locally heavy rainfall along the coast with more showery conditions expected this weekend.
Cooler temperatures arrive later this weekend and remain through next week areawide. There will be multiple chances for light precipitation, including light snow or snow showers for the higher peaks of the White Mountains.

PHI.excerpt: A cold front passes through the region this morning and cooler and drier air builds into the region.

CTP.excerpt: ) Seasonably cooler this weekend into next week with bulk of precipitation confined near and southeast of Lake Erie

RLX.excerpt:
) Pleasant days and chilly nights are expected through early next week, with frost/freeze conditions possible most mornings.
) Next precipitation chances arrive with a system late next week.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Some snow Friday morning, best at Mount Snow.
paras: Light snow Friday morning to Friday afternoon: Mount Snow {{s:2.7}}, Okemo {{s:1.9}}, Stratton {{s:1}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:0,13.5}} at Mount Snow. It's a nor'easter setup, one that usually favors Mount Snow, Okemo and Stratton.
Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:27}} to {{t:47}}, with up to {{s:1.2}} of snow.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 30).
Trend: totals have come down since yesterday.
NWS Burlington forecasters, Saturday 2:12 AM: "A cooler and unsettled pattern is expected this weekend with summit level snow possible Sunday morning."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

writeups.name: New Hampshire
writeups.title: Some snow Saturday evening, best at Cannon.
paras: Light snow Saturday evening to Sunday morning: Cannon {{s:3.1}}, Bretton Woods {{s:2.5}}, Wildcat {{s:1.6}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:0,8.6}} at Cannon. Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:28}} to {{t:51}}, with up to {{s:3.4}} of snow.
Bretton Woods usually opens first here, around Nov 15. Waterville Valley gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 20).
Trend: totals have gone up since yesterday, led by Bretton Woods ({{s:2.8}} to {{s:4.5}}).
NWS Gray forecasters, Saturday 1:43 AM: "Beneficial rainfall expands inland tonight with locally heavy rainfall along the coast with more showery conditions expected this weekend."

writeups.name: Massachusetts, Pennsylvania and West Virginia
writeups.title: Thursday morning storm: up to {{s:8.2}} at Seven Springs.
paras: The main event runs Thursday morning to Friday night. Seven Springs {{s:8.2}}, Snowshoe {{s:4.6}}, Jiminy Peak {{s:1}} at the summits, though the models range from {{r:0.1,11.3}} at Seven Springs. It's a northwest upslope setup, one that usually favors Seven Springs and Jiminy Peak. Rain mixes in even up high at times. Confidence is low so far (17% odds of {{s:6}}+), so expect changes.
Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:29}} to {{t:52}}, with rain at times.
Snowshoe usually opens first here, around Nov 27. Nights stay too mild to make much snow this week.
NWS Albany forecasters, Saturday 12:52 AM: ") An upper level low will bring periods of rain to the region today into early Sunday though no hydrological impacts are expected."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.
